# WTA Singles World Rankings - complete list: Sabalenka hits 100 weeks at the top, Rybakina close second

Discover the top 100 women's singles players in the world right now, as the best tennis players battle for glory on the WTA Tour.

Picture by Matthias Hangst/Getty Images

By [Olympics.com](https://www.olympics.com/en/author/olympics-com)

Updated on 03 August 2026 10:43 GMT+0 2 min read

Who is the best female [tennis](https://olympics.com/en/sports/tennis/) player in the world?

Based on the WTA singles rankings, [**Aryna Sabalenka**](https://www.olympics.com/en/athletes/aryna-sabalenka) remains the long-undisputed world No.1.

After rising to the top in October 2024, it has now been over 100 weeks at the ranking's summit for the 28-year-old.

The [2026 Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year](https://www.olympics.

# WTA Rankings: Current Women’s Tennis Rankings, Points System & No. 1 History

Photo of author

[Paul C](https://toomanyrackets.com/author/pctennis/)

Last Updated: April 1, 2026

The [WTA rankings](https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings/singles) are the official system used to rank the [best female tennis players](https://toomanyrackets.com/alphabetical-list-of-tennis-players-active-a-z/) in the world.

Updated every Monday, they determine seedings, tournament entry, and qualification across the [WTA Tour](https://toomanyrackets.com/2026-wta-tour-schedule/) .

Below you’ll find the latest WTA rankings, a breakdown of the points system, and a full history of world number 1 players.

[Aryna Sabalenka](https://toomanyrackets.com/aryna-sabalenka-schedule/) is the current world no 1 female [tennis player](https://toomanyrackets.com/atp-tennis-players-birthdays/) in the WTA rankings, ahead of other top 10 players like [Coco Gauff](https://toomanyrackets.

The average age of the top 100 female [tennis players](https://toomanyrackets.com/alphabetical-list-of-tennis-players-active-a-z/) is just under **26 years old** , with the highest-ranked female player 21 or under being [Victoria Mboko](https://toomanyrackets.com/top-canadian-tennis-players/) , while the oldest player ranked in the top 100 is currently **Tatjana Maria and Laura Siegemund** (38).

The youngest players currently in the WTA top 100 are **Mirra Andreeva** and **Iva Jovic** who are both 18 years old.

## WTA Ranking System Explained

A player’s **WTA Ranking** is based on their performance at a maximum of 16 tournaments for singles and 11 for doubles over a 52-week period.

...

### WTA 125 Points Breakdown

Winners of WTA 125 singles and doubles events receive 125 points, while the runner-up receives 81 points.

|**Finalist** |81 |

|**Quarterfinalist** |27 |
|**2nd Round** |15 |
|**1st Round** |1 |

## WTA Rankings History – World No.1s from 1975 to 2026

The WTA Rankings system is the method used by the WTA to see who should qualify and who should be seeded in the different singles and doubles [WTA Tournaments](https://toomanyrackets.com/2024-wta-tournament-schedule/) that are held all across the globe.

The first female tennis rankings were published by the WTA on the 3rd of November 1975 with **Chris Evert** being the first female tennis player to be ranked number 1 in the world.

Since then a total of 29 different women have achieved the WTA no 1 status in the official rankings, with the current number 1 being **Aryna Sabalenka** .

## FAQ

### How often are WTA rankings updated?

Every Monday based on results from the previous 52 weeks.

### How are WTA rankings calculated?

Players earn points from their best 16 tournaments over a rolling 52-week period.

### Who is world number 1 in women’s tennis?

Aryna Sabalenka is the current world number 1 in women’s tennis.

### How many points do you get for winning a Grand Slam?

A player receives 2,000 ranking points for winning a Grand Slam singles title.

### What is the difference between WTA rankings and the WTA Race?
The WTA rankings are based on results over the last 52 weeks, while the WTA Race tracks points earned during the current season only.

### Who was the first WTA world No. 1?

Chris Evert was the first official WTA world No. 1 when the rankings began in 1975.
